chain.label: Scaled's hazard analysis ignored single human error
chain.trigger: Scaled did not account for the possibility that a pilot might prematurely unlock the feather system

chain.label: FAA/AST permit evaluation deficient; human-error hazard requirements waived
chain.trigger: the FAA/AST issued the waivers without understanding whether the mitigations would adequately protect against a single human error with catastrophic consequences

chain.label: No barrier to premature unlock; actuators could not hold feather in transonic region
chain.trigger: The SS2 feather system had no design barrier that prevented a flight crewmember from erroneously unlocking the feather during the transonic region

caused_by.evidence: Scaled determined that the feather system design was adequate and that no mitigations were needed
the evaluations failed to recognize that Scaled Composites' hazard analysis did not meet regulatory requirements to identify hazards caused by human error

chain.label: Copilot lacked recent powered-flight experience; simulator did not model loads or early-unlock consequences
chain.trigger: the copilot did not have recent experience with the vibration and loads that occurred during the flight... had not flown SS2 under power since PF01 in April 2013

caused_by.evidence: Scaled relied solely on flight crew performance (through training and following the flight test data card procedures) to mitigate the catastrophic hazard

chain.label: Unlock speed not cross-checked by pilot flying
chain.trigger: because of the high workload during the boost phase of flight, the speed for unlocking the feather was not cross-checked by the pilot flying

caused_by.evidence: if Scaled had incorporated a pilot flying/pilot monitoring challenge and response protocol for the unlocking task... the task would have been redundant

chain.label: Copilot's high workload: memorized tasks, time pressure, vibration and G loads
chain.trigger: the copilot was experiencing high workload as a result of recalling tasks from memory while performing under time pressure and with vibration and loads that he had not recently experienced

caused_by.evidence: The lack of recent experience with powered flight vibration and loads could have increased the copilot's stress and thus his workload during a critical phase of flight

chain.label: Copilot unlocked the feather at 0.82 Mach instead of 1.4 Mach
chain.trigger: he incorrectly unlocked the feather immediately afterward instead of waiting until SS2 reached the required speed of 1.4 Mach

caused_by.evidence: time pressure was likely a stressor that contributed to the copilot incorrectly recalling the sequence of his tasks and unlocking the feather prematurely
the speed for unlocking the feather was not cross-checked by the pilot flying

chain.label: Uncommanded feather extension
chain.trigger: the feather extended uncommanded... the aerodynamic and inertial loads imposed on the feather flap assembly were sufficient to overcome the feather actuators

caused_by.evidence: the unlocking of the feather during the transonic region resulted in uncommanded feather operation
the external aerodynamic loads on the feather flap assembly were greater than the capability of the feather actuators to hold the assembly in the unfeathered position with the locks disengaged

chain.label: Rapid pitch up; vehicle folded about the feather hinge line
chain.trigger: The pitch rate increased rapidly, and the vehicle essentially folded in half about the feather flap hinge line, causing a catastrophic structural failure

caused_by.evidence: The feather flap assembly began moving relative to the wing... the loads imposed on the vehicle were sufficient to overcome the feather actuators

chain.label: SS2 broke up in flight at 46,000 ft
chain.trigger: SS2 broke up into multiple pieces during a rocket-powered test flight... about 13 seconds before the structural breakup

caused_by.evidence: the localized stress in the wing side of the inboard feather flap hinge fittings was sufficient to fracture the inboard hinges

chain.label: Wreckage impacted terrain over a 5-mile area
chain.trigger: impacted terrain over a 5-mile area near Koehn Dry Lake, California

caused_by.evidence: SS2 broke up into multiple pieces... and impacted terrain

chain.label: Copilot fatally injured, pilot seriously injured
chain.trigger: The pilot received serious injuries, and the copilot received fatal injuries

caused_by.evidence: During the breakup sequence, the pilot was thrown from the vehicle while still restrained in his seat
an autopsy on the copilot... determined that his cause of death was multiple blunt force trauma
